spec.description: One zone, with its outline. The outline is most of what a zone is, so the client hands back the whole GeoJSON feature: `geometry` is the area, `properties` the rest.

request.title: GetZoneRequest
request.description: Which zone, and as of when.

zone_id.description: Zone code, such as `WAZ315`. `points.get_point` returns the forecast, county and fire-weather zones of a place as URLs ending in one.

zone_type.description: The zone type. Any of them finds a zone of another type too (`/zones/forecast/PZZ135` answers the coastal zone), but the code decides what comes back.

effective.description: Answer as the zone stood at this time rather than now. Before the zone took effect the service answers 404.
